title: Your Agent Might Actually Lie to You
tagline: Six field notes from building a gate that makes a coding agent prove it is done.
description: I built GuardianKane for the Kane CLI hackathon: a Claude Code Stop hook that refuses to let the agent finish until Kane CLI has checked the work in a real browser. These six pieces are what the build, four paired experiments, and a re-read of my own logs taught me about trusting an agent's claim of done.
